يشتويا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَوِيَا (yaštawiyā) /jaʃ.ta.wi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# يُشْتَوَيَا (yuštawayā) /juʃ.ta.wa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
